answer_1.quote: In the Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) framework for human evaluation of machine translation (MT), expert annotators identify error spans within translations...

answer_4.quote: Human raters can exhibit different behaviors when rating NLG outputs... In the MQM framework, expert annotators identify error spans within translations and assign a hierarchical category (e.g., Fluency/Grammar or Accuracy/Mistranslation) and severity (Major or Minor).
answer_4.guideline: Raters annotate error spans, assign categories and severity levels according to the MQM annotation guidelines.
